rules: Start every page from a page template. Never lay out a page from scratch.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it. Add blocks and components inside its sections.
Keep the template's page frame, gap, and padding values. Replace its data, copy, and sections.
No <div>/raw HTML for layout — use VStack/HStack/Grid/Stack/Card etc.
No style={{}} — use component props, and design tokens for values.
Wrap the app in <Theme theme={...}> (import {Theme} from '@astryxdesign/core/theme') and import core reset.css + astryx.css.

templates.name: AI Chat Conversation
templates.description: Transcript of alternating turns carrying mixed rich content inline (markdown, code blocks, collapsible tool-call output) beside a resizable artifact panel that holds generated output while the stream keeps scrolling.

templates.name: AI Chat Landing
templates.description: Zero-state entry surface centered on a single composer with suggestion chips instead of history, sized for the moment before any content exists.

templates.name: Analytics Dashboard
templates.description: Three-band analytics: a row of headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all re-reading from one global filter bar.

templates.name: Basic Login
templates.description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention.

templates.name: Blank
templates.description: Bare scaffold: one heading slot, one empty content region, no navigation and no chrome.

templates.name: Canvas Editor
templates.description: Layered artboard workspace: document tabs over a layer rail, a fixed-size frame you zoom on a muted backdrop, and an inspector of position, type, and filter fields that retargets to the selected layer.

templates.name: Card Grid
templates.description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them.

templates.name: Centered Hero
templates.description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing.

templates.name: Checkout Form
templates.description: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total.

templates.name: Checkout Wizard
templates.description: Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change.

templates.name: Classic Gallery
templates.description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place.

templates.name: Collapsible Table
templates.description: Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns — for groups that do not share a schema, where one table would stand full of empty cells.

templates.name: Comparison Table
templates.description: Transposed matrix that puts candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column that survives horizontal scroll, columns you can swap or add, and best-in-row marks you can toggle.

templates.name: Contact Form
templates.description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit.

templates.name: Data Dashboard
templates.description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath.

templates.name: Dialog Wizard
templates.description: Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was.

templates.name: Documentation Catalog
templates.description: Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself.

templates.name: Documentation Design
templates.description: Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks.

templates.name: Documentation Technical
templates.description: Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links.

templates.name: Executive Summary Dashboard
templates.description: Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow.

templates.name: File Explorer
templates.description: Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node.

templates.name: Filterable Table
templates.description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.

templates.name: Form Wizard
templates.description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields.

templates.name: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
templates.description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap.

templates.name: Gallery Hero
templates.description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set.

templates.name: Grouped Table
templates.description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse.

templates.name: IDE
templates.description: Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite.

templates.name: Inbox Table
templates.description: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize.

templates.name: Incident Console
templates.description: Dense row queue with an inspector: severity-coded rows grouped by status, a saved-search filter bar, a segmented status control, and a resizable detail pane for the selected row.

templates.name: Inline Wizard
templates.description: Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in.

templates.name: Kanban Board
templates.description: Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change.

templates.name: Login Card
templates.description: Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath.

templates.name: Login Split
templates.description: Credential form filling one half of a two-pane split, full-bleed media holding the other.

templates.name: Login SSO
templates.description: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback.

templates.name: Messaging Shell
templates.description: Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next.

templates.name: Mixed Gallery
templates.description: Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile.

templates.name: Order Detail
templates.description: Single-record detail in two columns: a summary header with status and actions, a repeating line-item list, a totals block that sums it, and a chronological activity timeline in the rail.

templates.name: Page Editor
templates.description: Three-pane authoring workspace: a source palette on one flank, a live canvas in the middle, and an inspector that retargets to whatever is selected.

templates.name: Portfolio Dashboard
templates.description: Analytics for a value-over-time question: balance and change tiles above a stacked area chart of composition through time, closing on a ranked table of the largest contributors.

templates.name: Product Detail
templates.description: Single-item detail pairing a media gallery with a selection column: variant swatches, a quantity stepper, primary and secondary commit actions, and collapsible specification sections below.

templates.name: Product Gallery
templates.description: Uniform card grid where every tile carries media, title, supporting line, and a price.

templates.name: Project Status Dashboard
templates.description: Status analytics mixing progress and time-axis shapes: a completion donut, a horizontal timeline of dated bars against a today marker, a per-owner table with progress and status, an at-risk list, and a burndown.

templates.name: Searchable Table
templates.description: Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once — a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers — with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail, and totals derived from the visible rows that flag themselves as partial while a filter is on.

templates.name: Service Monitoring Dashboard
templates.description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow.

templates.name: Settings Dialog
templates.description: Preferences inside a modal container with searchable section navigation, so configuration happens without leaving whatever is underneath.

templates.name: Settings Form
templates.description: Preferences as one continuously scrolling form, sections stacked in order with no navigation between them.

templates.name: Settings Panels
templates.description: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form.

templates.name: Shell Nav
templates.description: Application frame combining both navigation axes: a top menu bar with command-palette search over a resizable hierarchy rail, wrapping placeholder content.

templates.name: Side Gallery
templates.description: Asymmetric split section: a copy column of headline, supporting text, and links held against a clustered image collage opposite.

templates.name: Side Nav
templates.description: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content.

templates.name: Simple Table
templates.description: Flat row collection where columns sort, rows select into a bulk-action toolbar, and each row carries an overflow menu.

templates.name: Theme Showcase
templates.description: Several unrelated product surfaces rendered together on one canvas so a token change can be judged across contexts at once.

templates.name: Top Nav
templates.description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.

templates.name: Tree Table
templates.description: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children — a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README.

templates.name: Two-column Form
templates.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll.

templates.name: Vertical Wizard
templates.description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field.

templates.name: Work Item Detail
templates.description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items.
